<p><strong>实战推荐：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://juejin.cn/post/7511332054941188147" target="_blank" title="https://juejin.cn/post/7511332054941188147">⚡ 一个Vue自定义指令搞定丝滑拖拽列表，告别复杂组件封装
</a></li>
<li><a href="https://juejin.cn/post/7543806966926802971" target="_blank" title="https://juejin.cn/post/7543806966926802971">🔥 这才是 Vue 驱动的 Chrome 插件工程化正确打开方式</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>还在为每个列表页写重复的分页代码而烦恼吗？ 还在复制粘贴 currentPage、pageSize、loading 等状态吗？ 一个 Hook 帮你解决所有分页痛点，减少90%重复代码</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">背景与痛点</h2>
<p>在后台管理系统开发中，分页列表查询非常常见，我们通常需要处理：</p>
<ul>
<li>当前页、页大小、总数等分页状态</li>
<li>加载中、错误处理等请求状态</li>
<li>搜索、刷新、翻页等分页操作</li>
<li>数据缓存和重复请求处理</li>
</ul>
<p>这些重复逻辑分散在各个组件中，维护起来很麻烦。</p>
<p>为了解决这个烦恼，我专门封装了分页数据管理 Hook。现在只需要几行代码，就能轻松实现分页查询，省时又高效，减少了大量重复劳动</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">使用前提 - 接口格式约定</h2>
<p>查询接口返回的数据格式：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">{
  <span class="hljs-attr">list</span>: [        <span class="hljs-comment">// 当前页数据数组</span>
    { <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'user1'</span> },
    { <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'user2'</span> }
  ],
  <span class="hljs-attr">total</span>: <span class="hljs-number">100</span>     <span class="hljs-comment">// 数据总条数</span>
}
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-2">先看效果：分页查询只需几行代码！</h2>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> usePageFetch <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/hooks/usePageFetch'</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 引入分页查询 Hook，封装了分页逻辑和状态管理</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { getUserList } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/api/user'</span>        <span class="hljs-comment">// 引入请求用户列表的 API 方法</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 使用 usePageFetch Hook 实现分页数据管理</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {
  currentPage,      <span class="hljs-comment">// 当前页码</span>
  pageSize,         <span class="hljs-comment">// 每页条数</span>
  total,            <span class="hljs-comment">// 数据总数</span>
  data,             <span class="hljs-comment">// 当前页数据列表</span>
  isFetching,       <span class="hljs-comment">// 加载状态，用于控制 loading 效果</span>
  search,           <span class="hljs-comment">// 搜索方法</span>
  onSizeChange,     <span class="hljs-comment">// 页大小改变事件处理方法</span>
  onCurrentChange   <span class="hljs-comment">// 页码改变事件处理方法</span>
} = <span class="hljs-title function_">usePageFetch</span>(
  getUserList,  <span class="hljs-comment">// 查询API</span>
  { <span class="hljs-attr">initFetch</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span> }  <span class="hljs-comment">// 是否自动请求一次（组件挂载时自动拉取第一页数据）     </span>
)
</code></pre>
<p>这样子每次分页查询只需要引入hook，然后传入查询接口就好了，减少了大量重复劳动</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-3">解决方案</h2>
<p>我设计了两个相互配合的 Hook：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>useFetch</strong>：基础请求封装，处理请求状态和缓存</li>
<li><strong>usePageFetch</strong>：分页逻辑封装，专门处理分页相关的状态和操作</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">usePageFetch (分页业务层)
├── 管理 page / pageSize / total 状态
├── 处理搜索、刷新、翻页逻辑  
├── 统一错误处理和用户提示
└── 调用 useFetch (请求基础层)
    ├── 管理 loading / data / error 状态
    ├── 可选缓存机制（避免重复请求）
    └── 成功回调适配不同接口格式
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-4">核心实现</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">useFetch - 基础请求封装</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// hooks/useFetch.js</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { ref } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Cache</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Map</span>()

<span class="hljs-comment">/**
 * 基础请求 Hook
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">Function</span>} <span class="hljs-variable">fn</span> - 请求函数
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">Object</span>} <span class="hljs-variable">options</span> - 配置选项
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">*</span>} options.initValue - 初始值
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">string|Function</span>} options.cache - 缓存配置
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">Function</span>} options.onSuccess - 成功回调
 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useFetch</span>(<span class="hljs-params">fn, options = {}</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> isFetching = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> data = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>()
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> error = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>()

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 设置初始值</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (options.<span class="hljs-property">initValue</span> !== <span class="hljs-literal">undefined</span>) {
    data.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = options.<span class="hljs-property">initValue</span>
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-params">...args</span>) {
    isFetching.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> promise

    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (options.<span class="hljs-property">cache</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cacheKey = <span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> options.<span class="hljs-property">cache</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'function'</span>
        ? options.<span class="hljs-title function_">cache</span>(...args)
        : options.<span class="hljs-property">cache</span> || <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${fn.name}</span>_<span class="hljs-subst">${args.join(<span class="hljs-string">'_'</span>)}</span>`</span>

      promise = <span class="hljs-title class_">Cache</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">get</span>(cacheKey) || <span class="hljs-title function_">fn</span>(...args)
      <span class="hljs-title class_">Cache</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(cacheKey, promise)
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
      promise = <span class="hljs-title function_">fn</span>(...args)
    }

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 成功回调处理</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (options.<span class="hljs-property">onSuccess</span>) {
      promise = promise.<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(options.<span class="hljs-property">onSuccess</span>)
    }

    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> promise
      .<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">res</span> =&gt;</span> {
        data.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = res
        isFetching.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
        error.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">undefined</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> res
      })
      .<span class="hljs-title function_">catch</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">err</span> =&gt;</span> {
        isFetching.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
        error.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = err
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">reject</span>(err)
      })
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
    fetch,
    isFetching,
    data,
    error
  }
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> useFetch

</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">usePageFetch - 分页逻辑封装</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// hooks/usePageFetch.js</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { ref, onMounted, toRaw, watch } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> useFetch <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./useFetch'</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 即上面的hook ---&gt; useFetch </span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">ElMessage</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'element-plus'</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">/**
 * 分页数据管理 Hook
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">Function</span>} <span class="hljs-variable">fn</span> - 请求函数
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">Object</span>} <span class="hljs-variable">options</span> - 配置选项
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">Object</span>} options.params - 默认参数
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">boolean</span>} options.initFetch - 是否自动初始化请求
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">Ref</span>} options.formRef - 表单引用
 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">usePageFetch</span>(<span class="hljs-params">fn, options = {}</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 分页状态</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> page = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> pageSize = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-number">10</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> total = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> data = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>([])
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> params = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>()
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> pendingCount = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>)

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 初始化参数</span>
  params.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = options.<span class="hljs-property">params</span>

  <span class="hljs-comment">//  使用基础请求 Hook</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { isFetching, <span class="hljs-attr">fetch</span>: fetchFn, error, <span class="hljs-attr">data</span>: originalData } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useFetch</span>(fn)

  <span class="hljs-comment">//  核心请求方法</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params">searchParams, pageNo, size</span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 更新分页状态</span>
      page.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = pageNo
      pageSize.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = size
      params.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = searchParams

      <span class="hljs-comment">// 发起请求</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchFn</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">page</span>: pageNo,
        <span class="hljs-attr">pageSize</span>: size,
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 使用 toRaw 避免响应式对象问题</span>
        ...(searchParams ? <span class="hljs-title function_">toRaw</span>(searchParams) : {})
      })

      <span class="hljs-comment">// 处理响应数据</span>
      data.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = originalData.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>?.<span class="hljs-property">list</span> || []
      total.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = originalData.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>?.<span class="hljs-property">total</span> || <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
      pendingCount.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = originalData.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>?.<span class="hljs-property">pendingCounts</span> || <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (e) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'usePageFetch error:'</span>, e)
      <span class="hljs-title class_">ElMessage</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">error</span>(e?.<span class="hljs-property">msg</span> || e?.<span class="hljs-property">message</span> || <span class="hljs-string">'请求出错'</span>)
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 清空数据，提供更好的用户体验</span>
      data.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = []
      total.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
    }
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">//  搜索 - 重置到第一页</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">search</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params">searchParams</span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(searchParams, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, pageSize.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>)
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 刷新当前页</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">refresh</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(params.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>, page.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>, pageSize.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>)
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 改变页大小</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onSizeChange</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params">size</span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(params.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, size) <span class="hljs-comment">// 重置到第一页</span>
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 切换页码</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onCurrentChange</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params">pageNo</span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(params.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>, pageNo, pageSize.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>)
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 组件挂载时自动请求</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">onMounted</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (options.<span class="hljs-property">initFetch</span> !== <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-title function_">search</span>(params.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>)
    }
  })

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 监听表单引用变化（可选功能）</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">watch</span>(
    <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> options.<span class="hljs-property">formRef</span>,
    <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">formRef</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (formRef) {
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Form ref updated:'</span>, formRef)
      }
    }
  )

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 分页状态</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">currentPage</span>: page,
    pageSize,
    total,
    pendingCount,
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 数据状态</span>
    data,
    originalData,
    isFetching,
    error,
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 操作方法</span>
    search,
    refresh,
    onSizeChange,
    onCurrentChange
  }
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> usePageFetch
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-7">完整使用示例</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-8">用element ui举例</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">&lt;template&gt;
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">el-form</span> <span class="hljs-attr">:model</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"searchForm"</span> &gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">el-form-item</span> <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"用户名"</span>&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">el-input</span> <span class="hljs-attr">v-model</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"searchForm.username"</span> /&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">el-form-item</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">el-form-item</span>&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">el-button</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"primary"</span> @<span class="hljs-attr">click</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"handleSearch"</span>&gt;</span>搜索<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">el-button</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">el-form-item</span>&gt;</span>

  <span class="hljs-title function_">search</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">username</span>: searchForm.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>.<span class="hljs-property">username</span> })

<h2 data-id="heading-9">高级用法</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-10">带缓存</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {
  data,
  isFetching,
  search
} = <span class="hljs-title function_">usePageFetch</span>(getUserList, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">cache</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">params</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-string">`user-list-<span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-built_in">JSON</span>.stringify(params)}</span>`</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 自定义缓存 key</span>
})
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-11">设计思路解析</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>职责分离</strong>：useFetch 专注请求状态管理，usePageFetch 专注分页逻辑</li>
<li><strong>统一错误处理</strong>：在 usePageFetch 层统一处理错误</li>
<li><strong>智能缓存机制</strong>：支持多种缓存策略</li>
<li><strong>生命周期集成</strong>：自动在组件挂载时请求数据</li>
</ul>
<h2 data-id="heading-12">总结</h2>
<p>这套分页管理 Hook 的优势：</p>
<ul>
<li>开发效率高，减少90%的重复代码，新增列表页从 30 分钟缩短到 5 分钟</li>
<li>状态管理完善，自动处理加载、错误、数据状态</li>
<li>缓存机制，避免重复请求</li>
<li>错误处理统一，用户体验一致</li>
<li>易于扩展，支持自定义配置和回调</li>
</ul>
